display.purpose: One per screen, with a yellow marker underline.

label.purpose: Badges, times and hints; never below 18px.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one decision on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0B2A6F; color: #fff; min-height: 64px; padding: .6rem 2rem; border: 3px solid #0B2A6F; border-radius: 12px; font: 800 1.2rem system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #061B4D; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #0B2A6F; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px #FFE14D; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(2px); }

components.name: Block Button
components.description: Primary action when blocking is the safe choice.
components.css: .ds-btn-block { background: #A3121F; color: #fff; min-height: 64px; padding: .6rem 2rem; border: 3px solid #7D0C17; border-radius: 12px; font: 800 1.2rem system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-block:hover { background: #7D0C17; } .ds-btn-block:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #0B2A6F; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px #FFE14D; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; padding: .25rem .8rem; border: 2px solid #0A6B3A; border-radius: 8px; background: #D3F0DF; color: #0A6B3A; font: 700 1rem system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Message Row
components.description: Picture tile, sender and subject, status.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; padding: 1rem; border: 3px solid #0B2A6F; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: #0B1B44; font: 1rem system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pic { width: 3.5rem; height: 3.5rem; border: 3px solid #0A6B3A; border-radius: 12px; background: #D3F0DF; }

narrative.overview: Backstop looks like the easy-read documents made for people who find ordinary text hard: one short sentence, one drawn picture, one button. Everything is large, outlined and flat.
keyCharacteristics: Every box has a 3px navy outline and no shadow.
Every statement is paired with a picture tile.
The single decision on a screen is the biggest, heaviest control.
State is always icon, word and colour together.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Green, orange and red mean safe, waiting and blocked and nothing else; each always has an icon and a word beside it.

rules.name: The Thick Marker Rule
rules.body: Titles get one yellow highlighter stroke; no other text is highlighted, gradient-filled or colour-washed.

rules.name: The Outline Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a box needs to stand apart, outline it.

dos: Do pair every statement with a picture tile and every state with icon, word and colour.
Do make the one decision the biggest, heaviest control on the screen.
Do keep text at 18px or larger and targets at 56px or larger.
donts: Don't use shadows, gradients or glass; outline the box instead.
Don't use yellow to mean a state.
Don't colour a status without an icon and a word.
